summary: Live tracking on charts: Stratos offers the chart for the fix you're flying to and shows your aircraft on it.
releaseNotes: When your next fix is printed on one of your route's charts, the Flight Deck asks "Continue track on {chart}?" and Yes opens that chart in Charts.
Charts shows your live aircraft on the open chart, in the same place as on the Flight Deck, even on charts that are not drawn to scale.
Charts can be opened straight to one chart from a link.
